description: Become a Yoga Democracy Affiliate. Get Early access, creator benefits, and earn commission. Our program highlights mission driven, passion led individuals who have made a positive impact in our community.

blocks.text: Member Benefits:Custom made to fit into your schedule for aligned flexibility and growth!
Early AccessBe the first to know about seasonal launches, promotions, & updates!
Creator Benefits Get access to priority placement, seasonal gratis product, bonuses, & more!
Earn MoreEarn commission with our code based program designed for growth!
Join the Journey:
﻿Partnering with leaders in the community sharing a common goal to build a better future through sustainable practice & alignment.
FAQS
How do I apply? >
Simply click the link to your desired program and follow the prompts!
Who is the program for? >
Our program is for anyone looking to make a positive impact in the world! We can’t wait for you to join us!
Is there a charge to sign up? >
There is no charge for sign up.
Can my friends and family use any discounts I receive? >
Absolutely! We love that you want to spread the love with your friends and family.
How long does the approval process take for my application? >
Due to the amount of applications we receive daily, please allow up to 20 days to receive a response.
